stores.name: wordpress_files

stores.restore: new isolated DB; no import into original; do not resume old grants or reset attempt counters

stores.name: publisher_journal
stores.restore: existing restoreBackup to new readonly store; unknown operations GET-only, never auto-replay

stores.name: scanner_sqlite
required: SQLite consistent backup API after quiescence
